# `mwana`
An efficient workflow for plausibility checks and prevalence analysis of wasting in R
![](mwana.jpeg){.absolute bottom=250 right=5}

## What is `mwana`? {.smaller}
<br>

- A code that **streamlines data quality checks** of and acute undernutrition **prevalence estimation** from anthropometric data of children aged 6 to 59 months old. 

## What does `mwana` do? {.smaller}

<br>

1. IPC sample size checker

2. Data plausibility checks of acute undernutrition anthropometric data of children 6-59 months old

3. Prevalence estimation of acute undernutrition

4. Reporting of data plausibility checks and prevalence estimation summary outputs

## Checking if IPC AMN sample size requirements are met {.smaller}

<br> 

```{r}
#| label: example1
#| eval: true
anthro.03 |>
  group_by(district) |> 
  mw_check_ipcamn_ssreq(
    cluster = cluster,
    .source = "survey"
  ) |> 
  kable()
```

<br>

+ It checks for: 
    - Survey
    - Screening
    - Sentinel sites

## Plausibility checks with `mwana` {.smaller}
<br> 

::: {.column width="50%"}
+ Weight-for-height z-scores
+ MUAC
    - MUAC-for-age z-score
    - Raw MUAC

:::

## WFHZ {.smaller}
```{r}
#| label: wfhz
#| eval: true
anthro.01 |>
  mw_wrangle_age(
    dos = dos,
    dob = dob,
    age = age,
    .decimals = 2
  ) |>
  mw_wrangle_wfhz(
    sex = sex,
    weight = weight,
    height = height,
    .recode_sex = TRUE
  ) |>
  group_by(area) |> 
  mw_plausibility_check_wfhz(
    sex = sex,
    age = age,
    weight = weight,
    height = height,
    flags = flag_wfhz
  ) |> 
  group_by(area) |> 
  mw_neat_output_wfhz() |> 
  kable()
```

## MFAZ {.smaller}

```{r}
#| label: mfaz
#| eval: true
data |> 
  select(Province,Cluster,Gender,Age,Muac,Poondidagi) |> 
  rename(
    province = Province,
    sex = Gender,
    age = Age,
    muac = Muac,
    edema = Poondidagi
    ) |> 
    mutate(
    muac = as.numeric(muac), 
    age = as.numeric(age)
    ) |> 
    mw_wrangle_age(
    dos = NULL,
    dob = NULL,
    age = age,
    .decimals = 2
    ) |> 
    mw_wrangle_muac(
    sex = sex,
    muac = muac,
    age = age,
    .recode_sex = FALSE,
    .recode_muac = TRUE,
    .to = "cm"
    ) |> 
    group_by(province) |> 
    mw_plausibility_check_mfaz(
    sex = sex,
    muac = muac,
    age = age,
    flags = flag_mfaz
    ) |> 
    group_by(province) |> 
    mw_neat_output_mfaz() |> 
    select(-c(`Overall score`, `Overall quality`)) |> 
    kable()
```

## Raw MUAC {.smaller}

+ To be used only when **variable age** is not available

```{r}
#| label: raw-muac
#| eval: true
data |> 
  select(Province,Cluster,Gender,Muac,Poondidagi) |> 
  rename(
    province = Province,
    sex = Gender,
    muac = Muac,
    edema = Poondidagi
    ) |> 
    mutate(
    muac = as.numeric(muac)
    ) |> 
    mw_wrangle_muac(
    sex = sex,
    muac = muac,
    .recode_sex = FALSE,
    .recode_muac = TRUE,
    .to = "cm"
    ) |> 
    group_by(province) |> 
    mw_plausibility_check_muac(
    sex = sex,
    muac = muac, 
    flags = flag_muac
    ) |> 
    group_by(province) |> 
    mw_neat_output_muac() |> 
    kable()
```

## WFHZ {.smaller}
- **GAM by WFHZ and/or edema**

| All(967): (55) 5.7% (4.4 - 7.4)| All(970): (53), 5.5% (4.0 - 7.0) | - 0.2%
| All(967): (11) 1.1% (0.6 - 2.2)| All(970): (10), 1.0% (0.2 - 1.8) | - 0.1 %

## GAM by MUAC and/or edema {.smaller}

```{r}
data |> 
  select(Province,Cluster,Gender,Age,Muac,Poondidagi) |> 
  rename(
    province = Province,
    sex = Gender,
    age = Age,
    muac = Muac,
    edema = Poondidagi
    ) |> 
    mutate(
    muac = as.numeric(muac), 
    age = as.numeric(age)
    ) |> 
    mw_wrangle_age(
    dos = NULL,
    dob = NULL,
    age = age,
    .decimals = 2
    ) |> 
    mw_wrangle_muac(
    sex = sex,
    muac = muac,
    age = age,
    .recode_sex = FALSE,
    .recode_muac = TRUE,
    .to = "cm"
    ) |> 
    mutate(
    muac = recode_muac(muac,.to = "mm")
  ) |> 
  mw_estimate_prevalence_screening(
    edema=edema,
    muac=muac,
    .by = province
  ) |> 
  kable()
```
